intro: Sunday June 28 morning tactical ideas for the June 29 (Monday) US and Korean sessions. The week ahead is defined by ONE dominant new development and THREE binary events: (NEW) Samsung + SK Hynix $646B joint Blue House announcement on June 29 — Samsung: ~$226B AI data centers + ~$194B semiconductor plants; SK Hynix: $29.4B ADR proceeds; the largest corporate investment in Korean history at presidential scale — this is the single most powerful AI sector demand catalyst of the 2026 cycle; (1) NVDA Stop Day 2 — June 29 US close above/below $195 determines full exit vs. framework reset (Samsung announcement raises reset probability to ~60–65%); (2) SK Hynix June 29 KST open — first live price discovery for both Blue House and ADR catalysts simultaneously; (3) NFP July 2 — consensus +172K into 3-day July 4 holiday gap. Regime gates still breached (SPX 106 pts below 7,460, VIX 18.41, DXY 101.27). BTC Day 6 exit gate active ($60,198, Fear & Greed 13). SPCX bond distribution Day 5 Monday. Do NOT add to NVDA before June 29 close. Do NOT re-enter BTC before two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc.
ideas.idea: BUY June 29 KST open on Samsung Blue House + ADR catalyst — UPGRADED to HIGH conviction. Samsung-SK Hynix joint Blue House announcement (June 29 morning KST, before US premarket): Samsung $646B including $226B AI data centers and $194B semiconductor plants + SK Hynix $29.4B ADR proceeds. Korean presidential endorsement eliminates forced-liquidation cascade risk. Buy if June 29 KST opens above ₩2,700,000 with KOSPI above 8,500.
ideas.why: The Blue House joint announcement creates three simultaneous institutional support structures absent during the June 23 and June 26 circuit-breaker sessions: (1) Korean presidential endorsement — political protection against KOSPI circuit-breaker cascades; (2) Samsung $226B AI data center demand — the most powerful external validation of SK Hynix's HBM4 thesis at national-government scale; (3) Underwriter stabilization mandate (BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan for ADR July 10) now backed by Blue House political support. The June 26 record retail net buy (₩11.55T circuit-breaker session) is confirmed as the capitulation bottom given the Blue House magnitude. Historical KOSPI precedent: dual-circuit-breaker episodes followed by +15–20% recoveries within 10 sessions.
ideas.trigger: June 29 KST opens above ₩2,700,000 AND KOSPI opens above 8,500 → buy 50% position. Add second 50% tranche after June 30 KST close confirms KOSPI stabilization above 8,500 (two-session KOSPI hold). Stop ₩2,540,000 on two consecutive KST daily closes below (unchanged).
ideas.risk: June 29 KST opens below ₩2,600,000 (US premarket risk-off from NVDA stop Day 2 trigger + KOSPI contagion); Samsung semiconductor plant expansion ($194B Honam) interpreted as HBM4E competitive threat vs. collaborative national plan; Samsung announces HBM4E NVIDIA qualification simultaneously with Blue House; ADR pricing supplement prices below filing range.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.idea: Stop Day 2 binary — June 29 close is the fulcrum; Samsung Blue House raises reset probability to ~60–65%. WATCH ONLY — do NOT add NVDA before June 29 resolves. If June 29 closes above $195 → stop resets inactive; upgrade to medium conviction HOLD; next add requires both SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17. If June 29 closes below $195 → FULL EXIT (two-close stop triggered); no re-entry until SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 AND NVDA > $205 simultaneously.
ideas.why: NVDA closed $192.53 on June 26 (−2.20%) despite the record $334B Nasdaq reconstitution — the largest passive buying event in exchange history produced a lower close. Stop Day 1 is active. Samsung Blue House June 29 ($226B AI data centers) is the most powerful demand-side validation in NVDA's history and directly raises the probability of a June 29 premarket gap above $195 (if KOSPI opens +4–5% on Samsung/SK Hynix combined catalyst, US premarket NVDA likely tracks above $195 in the first 30 minutes). However, an intraday gap that fails to hold through the session close still triggers the stop — only the June 29 daily close matters.
ideas.trigger: June 29 premarket above $197 (favorable stop reset setup) → hold; June 29 close above $195 → upgrade to medium HOLD; next add framework: $205 entry when SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 simultaneously. June 29 close below $195 → FULL EXIT at close or June 30 open.
ideas.risk: Samsung Blue House news was pre-positioned into Friday close, gap-up fades before June 29 US close; NFP pre-positioning risk-off (institutions de-risking ahead of July 2 into holiday gap) overwhelms Samsung catalyst; NVDA-specific negative news (hyperscaler capex guidance cut, Broadcom supply-chain commentary).

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: Samsung Blue House ($226B AI data centers) is the most powerful external validation of Micron's $50B Q4 FY2026 HBM4 guide. Buy the Monday dip if MU opens below $1,200. Samsung's AI data center buildout requires HBM memory — MU and SK Hynix are the two primary suppliers; the Samsung announcement is an implicit demand validation of MU's $50B guide at national-strategic scale.
ideas.why: Micron's $50B Q4 FY2026 revenue guide is the most powerful earnings beat of the 2026 AI cycle — 40%+ above prior consensus. HBM3E and HBM4 capacity sold out through 2026. SK Hynix ADR ($29.4B) and Samsung Blue House ($226B AI data centers) collectively confirm the HBM supercycle is structural, not cyclical — the same institutions that would fund a $29.4B ADR (BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan) and commit $226B in Samsung AI capex have verified HBM demand before committing. Russell Growth reclassification (June 26) creates permanent passive demand from Growth ETFs. Samsung Blue House removes the final counterargument to the Morningstar supply-glut thesis.
ideas.trigger: MU opens below $1,200 on June 29 → buy. If MU opens above $1,250 without pullback, wait for $1,200 zone. Stop $1,050 on two consecutive closes below. Size 25–40% of full position — SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 required for full allocation.
ideas.risk: Samsung semiconductor plant ($194B Honam) includes competing DRAM production that undercuts Micron pricing power; NFP July 2 hot print drives tech multiple compression ahead of MU Q4 earnings (~September 2026); Samsung Blue House news is front-run into the Monday open, MU gaps to $1,300 with no pull-to-buy-zone entry.

ideas.name: Bitcoin / US Dollar
ideas.idea: Remain FLAT/CASH. Monitor June 29 UTC close for Day 1 of re-entry clock. Samsung Blue House cross-asset risk-on is the primary catalyst for a June 29 UTC close above $62,000 (requires +3.0% from current $60,198). Day 6 exit gate active. Fear & Greed at 13 (Extreme Fear — strongest contrarian signal of the cycle). Higher-low basing sequence broken (June 28 low $59,748 < June 27 low $59,856). Do NOT re-enter before two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000.
ideas.why: IBIT outflows confirmed $445M June 26 (second-largest in streak); weekly outflows ~$1.3B. Fear & Greed at 13 — historically contrarian but does not override the two-close-$62,000 gate. BTC-AI semi correlation has been consistent in 2026: every NVDA +3%+ session was accompanied by BTC +1–3%; Samsung-driven NVDA gap of 3–5% on June 29 implies BTC +$1,800–$3,000, directly to the $62,000 re-entry gate. However, the $10.6B quarterly BTC options expiry and sustained IBIT outflows are structural headwinds that the Samsung catalyst must overcome.
ideas.trigger: June 29 20:00 UTC close above $62,000 → Day 1 of re-entry clock; watch June 30 20:00 UTC close: if also above $62,000 → re-enter at 50% position size. Stop: two consecutive UTC closes below $60,000 after re-entry. Do NOT re-enter before NFP July 2 even if Day 2 clock activates.
ideas.risk: Samsung Blue House drives BTC above $62,000 intraday but not on the June 29 UTC daily close (the only close that matters); NVDA stop triggers on June 29 US close (risk-off contagion drives BTC below $59,000); NFP July 2 strong print (+200K) into 3-day holiday gap forces BTC below $58,100 structural level.

ideas.name: Procure Space ETF
ideas.idea: STEP ASIDE HIGH conviction — zero position. Bond distribution Day 5 is Monday June 29 (critical volume read). Samsung Blue House macro risk-on may modestly reduce discretionary distribution selling — watch for volume below 80M shares on June 29 as the accelerated clearance signal. Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 (~$4.3B passive) remains the known demand catalyst at the clearance window.
ideas.why: The SpaceX $25B bond (formally settled June 26) distribution supply overwhelms all passive buying events until mechanical clearance occurs. $89B in demand from $25B supply means even 0.5% of allocants immediately selling creates $450M/day supply. Day 4 volume 126.91M shares is declining but still far above the 5M clearance signal. Samsung Blue House creates cross-sector risk-on that may reduce DISCRETIONARY selling on June 29 — this is an X-factor that could modestly accelerate the normalization pace but cannot overcome structural dealer distribution mechanics.
ideas.trigger: Volume below 5M shares/day for 2–3 consecutive sessions (est. July 7–10) → clearance confirmed; then watch for two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. If June 29 close below $150 → IG floor failure Day 1 → framework reassessment required. Samsung macro risk-on reduces probability of June 29 $150 breach.
ideas.risk: Bond distribution clears early (Samsung risk-on accelerates normalization, volume drops below 5M before July 7); Nasdaq 100 inclusion pre-positioning by QQQ managers drives SPCX above $185 before distribution clears — zero position misses the move; SpaceX announces major milestone that overrides distribution mechanics.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms Inc.
ideas.idea: Low-conviction watch: META is the best-risk-adjusted addition in big-tech once regime gates clear. Samsung Blue House creates AI data center demand context that benefits Meta's advertising AI thesis (more AI compute = more AI ad optimization demand). If June 29 closes see SPX above 7,420 (approaching 7,460 floor) AND VIX below 18, META becomes the first big-tech name to add before full regime clearance.
ideas.why: META is the reported anchor customer for Qualcomm Dragonfly AI chip — a structural hedge against NVIDIA dependency not yet priced. Reality Labs losses decelerating. Threads/Instagram AI engagement accelerating. Samsung $646B Blue House announcement validates the AI data center buildout narrative that directly benefits Meta's AI training and inference infrastructure decisions. Llama 4 open-source adoption creating enterprise AI ecosystem. PEG discount vs. MSFT and GOOGL at current multiples.
ideas.trigger: Both SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 close simultaneously (regime cleared) → add META on following session open. Stop: 7% below entry. Target: 10% above entry on 4-week horizon. Samsung Blue House may narrow the time to regime clearance.
ideas.risk: Regime gates remain breached through July NFP; FTC/EU regulatory action on Meta AI data practices; Qualcomm Dragonfly partnership delayed or reported inaccurately.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.idea: Low-conviction watch: MSFT is the enterprise AI moat play in big-tech with the most direct read-through from Samsung Blue House ($226B AI data centers). Samsung AI data centers compete with Microsoft Azure — but at national-government scale, the Samsung announcement validates that $226B in AI compute demand exists BEYOND what Azure and the US hyperscalers are already building; this incremental demand is not currently in MSFT's addressable market estimate and re-rates the global AI infrastructure TAM upward.
ideas.why: Azure is #2 hyperscaler growing faster than AWS on AI workloads. OpenAI partnership gives MSFT exclusive commercial rights to GPT-5/6 on Azure. Copilot for M365 (1.4B Office users) is the largest enterprise AI distribution channel. GitHub Copilot (1.4M+ paid seats). Samsung $226B AI data centers = global AI compute demand is larger than the market's current estimate; MSFT benefits as the enterprise AI software layer regardless of which hardware runs the compute. Do not add before regime gates clear.
ideas.trigger: SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 at daily close simultaneously (regime cleared) → add MSFT. Stop: 7% below entry. Samsung Blue House is the demand validation catalyst that narrows the time to regime clearance.
ideas.risk: Regime gates remain breached; OpenAI relationship deteriorates; GOOGL Workspace + Gemini gains enterprise share faster than MSFT Copilot; Samsung builds Azure-competitive cloud services with the $226B AI data center commitment, reducing MSFT global cloud market share.
